checks.detail: Identity, Fact, Story and Review contracts are generated and versioned.
Merge/split/name use immutable successors with proposal lineage.
Story reasoning is a typed multi-Activity Artifact pipeline.
L1 Gate publishes exact approved Story pointer and fails closed on blockers.
Legally usable multi-series identity gold corpus has not been provided.
Real Story severe-error and evidence-coverage evaluation awaits user data.
E06 provider production qualification remains rejected/pending human.
No real StoryReviewPackage has received project-owner approval.

severe_errors.description: A key event is assigned to the wrong character.
Story contains an event unsupported by source evidence.
Cause and effect are reversed or temporal order is asserted as causality.
Negation, dream, recall or hypothetical content is presented as present reality.
A key event required for narrative correctness is omitted.
Evidence link does not entail the reviewed claim.
